# AI-OFFICE (oficina-opencode)

> Multi-agent orchestration for OpenCode — dispatched teams of AI agents with a disk-based message bus, leases, non-bypassable quality gates and per-token evidence. MIT. npm: oficina-opencode.

## Docs
- [README](https://socrambt.github.io/AI-OFFICE/): overview + quick start
- [QUE-ES](https://socrambt.github.io/AI-OFFICE/QUE-ES.md): what it is, and what you have to know
- [GARANTIAS](https://socrambt.github.io/AI-OFFICE/GARANTIAS.md): invariants (gates gates fail-closed, evidence required, owner ≠ reviewer)
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://socrambt.github.io/AI-OFFICE/ARCHITECTURE.md): tools, hooks, state machine, circuit breaker
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/SOCRAMbt/AI-OFFICE/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute (humans and AIs)

## Releases
- [v3.3.1](https://github.com/SOCRAMbt/AI-OFFICE/releases/tag/v3.3.1): current — `npm install -g oficina-opencode`
- [npm latest](https://www.npmjs.com/package/oficina-opencode): weekly downloads and changelog
- [Release notes](https://github.com/SOCRAMbt/AI-OFFICE/releases): every release with full notes
